mechanism: Foscarnet causes electrolyte abnormalities (hypocalcemia, hypomagnesemia, hypokalemia) which are potentiated by triamcinolone's mineralocorticoid effects and immunosuppression increases infection risk in foscarnet-treated patients.
action: Monitor electrolytes closely, particularly calcium, magnesium, and potassium; use lowest effective corticosteroid dose; assess for secondary infections; consider alternative immunosuppressive agents if possible.
